questions.prompt: In a truss analyzed using the Method of Joints, what assumption is made about the joints?
options: All joints are rigid and carry bending moments
All joints are frictionless pinned connections carrying only axial forces
Loads can be applied anywhere along the length of members
questions.explanation: Ideal truss theory assumes frictionless pin joints, meaning members only experience pure axial tension or compression.

questions.prompt: According to the Parallel Axis Theorem, how is the moment of inertia I about any parallel axis distance d away calculated?
questions.explanation: The moment of inertia about an axis parallel to a centroidal axis is I_cm + m * d^2.
